sectors.trend: CBA brings forward rate hike forecast; RBA blunt warning signals sustained tight policy. Super contributions surge >33% post-budget, boosting AUM for fund managers. Higher rates support NIM but pressure credit growth.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from wider spreads but face rising credit-risk concerns. Super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPT.AX) gain from inflow surge. Digital pension scheme proposal (headline 51) could disrupt long-term super model.

sectors.trend: Iron ore under pressure with 'roaches seethe' commentary; gold discoveries at Forrestania (4 WA prefeasibility studies) and Aurum (3.22 Moz Côte d'Ivoire) lift junior miners. ASX small-caps Latrobe, CurveBeam, Arrow, Sultan lead weekly gains.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from soft iron ore. Gold juniors (FOR.AX, AUR.AX) and mid-tiers attract rotation. Commodity diversification critical.

sectors.trend: Diesel/petrol shock rising; Chevron CEO flags oil-price and economic concerns. Japan diverts Australian LNG, straining East Coast supply. Victoria retreats from renewable transmission. EV adoption accelerates as consumers flee bowser.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX face margin pressure from fuel costs. LNG exporters (WDS.AX, GSO.AX) benefit from Japan demand but East Coast gas scarcity raises domestic risk. Renewables (INC.AX, LNC.AX) hit by Victoria policy reversal.

sectors.trend: Dollar General CEO raises consumer red flag; discount fashion chain closes 120 stores. Fuel shock and rising rates squeeze household budgets. Food insecurity rising, charity school lunches expanding.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX, IAG.AX face demand softness. Discount retailers (WOW.AX) may gain share but margins compress. Consumer staples defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Auction market reality check; downsizing costs deter empty nesters. Rental market disruption proposed (cutting out agents). Housing density concerns. Higher rates pressure valuations.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICOL.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure. Property developers (SRG.AX, CGP.AX) under stress. Rental yield compression likely.

sectors.trend: AI chip buildout accelerates (ASML, TSMC, Amazon UK bond for AI). Warner Music AI revenue play. CSL and healthcare stable but dialysis shelter closures raise service-delivery concerns.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but CSL.AX, SVL.AX, XRO.AX benefit from global health/AI themes. CurveBeam (CBE.AX) among weekly ASX runners.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure into RBA decision. CBA rate hike forecast and blunt RBA warning create a hawkish bias. Oil and bond yield headwinds from Wall Street spill over. Expect ^AXJO to test support. Small-cap momentum (Latrobe, CurveBeam) provides pockets of strength. Fuel shock and consumer weakness cap upside. Net: cautious, range-bound with downside risk into RBA meeting.
market_outlook.long_term: 2027 recession odds rising and 'four horsemen' narrative suggest a challenging 6–12 month backdrop. However, gold discoveries, super inflow surge, and AI capex cycle provide structural support. Energy transition policy inconsistency (Victoria renewables retreat) creates uncertainty. Buffett succession and global AI buildout (Amazon, ASML) support risk assets long-term. Australian equity income (dividends) remains attractive if rates stabilise. Key swing factor: whether RBA hikes trigger a credit cycle slowdown.
